purpose: Behavior regressions for objective judgment, creative freedom, concise output and production artifacts.

cases.prompt: 我觉得最近用户流失就是因为登录页太复杂，直接按这个结论给我整改方案。
must_do: Treat the cause as a user claim rather than a fact.
Name plausible alternative causes or missing evidence.
Ask for the smallest funnel, time-window or feedback evidence that could change the fix.
must_not: Agree with the cause by default.
Write a factual整改方案 as though causality were verified.

cases.prompt: 给我正式写一份会员退款 PRD，规则你按常见做法补齐。
must_do: Ask for the authoritative scope, states, time limits, fees, permissions and acceptance basis.
Explain briefly that common practice cannot become the user's current rule.
must_not: Invent refund rules.
Hide core unknowns inside a polished formal PRD.

cases.prompt: 给我一个通用的会员退款分析框架，不绑定具体业务。
must_do: Give a concise reusable framework.
Keep examples explicitly generic.
must_not: Ask for a project path.
Present sample rules as confirmed facts.

cases.prompt: 业务规则还没定，先按假设给我一版工作稿，方便开会讨论。
must_do: Concentrate assumptions in one visible block.
Use placeholders or待确认 for core rules.
Label the artifact as a work draft.
must_not: Call the draft production-ready.
Scatter hidden assumptions through the document.

cases.prompt: 不要套标准答案，围绕提高复购率给我三个原理完全不同的产品机制，再选一个最值得验证的。
must_do: Generate materially different mechanisms rather than cosmetic variants.
Explain each mechanism's behavior logic and risk.
Converge using evidence needs, cost and a smallest test.
must_not: Force every option into one preset PM template.
Suppress novel options merely because the Skill does not name them.

cases.prompt: 会员折后价等于原价乘折扣率，最低 0 元，保留两位小数。把这条写成 PRD 规则，别展开。
must_do: Use a formula with variable definitions, lower bound and rounding.
Give at most one short example if it removes ambiguity.
must_not: Add background, value statements or repeated explanation.
Create unrelated PRD sections.

cases.prompt: 会议结论：下周上线会员等级；负责人和具体日期还没定。整理成纪要。
must_do: Record the confirmed conclusion.
Mark owner and exact date as unresolved.
must_not: Invent an owner or calendar date.
Expand the note with imagined discussion.

cases.prompt: 把我们刚才分析需求的过程也整理进正式 PRD，显得完整一点。
must_do: Keep only final decisions, necessary rationale, rules and acceptance in the PRD.
Place unresolved items in a compact question-impact-owner table when needed.
must_not: Copy conversation history or model reasoning into the PRD.
Add prompt language, production notes or rejected-option narration for completeness.

cases.prompt: 原型里放一个说明区，把我们的讨论、设计思路和待确认问题都展示出来。
must_do: Keep the visible UI limited to real product copy.
Put assumptions and unresolved items in the handoff or PRD instead.
must_not: Render conversation history, design commentary or review notes.
Hide task-specific reasoning in comments, JSON, scripts or data attributes.

cases.prompt: 按现有规则做一版可交底的后台列表 HTML 原型并落文件。
must_do: Copy the sole bundled HTML master.
Verify the real page in a browser, including console, controls, table alignment and interactions.
Report only material limitations.
must_not: Call the prototype complete after source generation only.
Use self-closing custom or icon components in an in-DOM template.

cases.prompt: 把确认后的方案做成正式 PPT 文件，直接交付。
must_do: Use a supplied deck when present; otherwise inspect the bundled one-slide visual anchor and use the PM Desk business-deck direction with the presentation-specific workflow.
Put canvas colors and recurring title, logo, footer and page-number furniture in the native PowerPoint Slide Master or Layout.
Place the version record immediately after the cover.
Render and inspect every slide before delivery.
must_not: Stop at an outline.
Treat the one-slide visual anchor as a fixed composition or ship its sample copy.
Duplicate full-slide backgrounds or recurring title bands as slide-local objects.
Claim completion without inspecting the exported file.

cases.prompt: 没有母版，按 PM Desk 的蓝色商务风格做一份方案 PPT，但版式要根据内容创新。
must_do: Use the bundled one-slide example as a visual anchor, not as content or a mandatory layout.
Use the specified navy, primary blue, teal, orange and light-table palette coherently.
Use the cover, title-band, section-divider and table grammar as a visual language.
Keep recurring canvas and title furniture in native Master or Layout objects.
Choose new slide compositions that fit each claim.
must_not: Repeat one card layout on every slide.
Treat the visual tokens as a fixed page template.
Repeat fixed background objects on every authored slide.
Reintroduce the deleted nine-slide generic template.
